en.name: Ñame, true tropical yam
en.summary: Ñame is the real tropical yam: rough-barked, starchy and sold in heavy lengths — not the sweet potato that American shops label as yam. It is a keeping crop, holding 2–4 months in a cool, dark, ventilated pantry, and should not be refrigerated whole.
en.pantry: A true yam is a keeping crop and the pantry is where it belongs: cool, dark, dry and above all well ventilated, spread out rather than piled, and never in a plastic bag. About 2–4 months is the working range — a figure borrowed from potatoes and stretched, because West African and Caribbean ñame is traditionally kept for months in a ventilated barn, far longer than a potato. No food safety agency publishes a home storage life for it. Check regularly for soft spots and rub sprouts off as they appear. If you cut a tuber, seal the cut face and use that one within days.
en.fridge: Do not refrigerate a whole ñame. Like other tropical roots it is chilling sensitive, and a cold fridge brings on internal browning and rot faster than a cool pantry does — the cold is actively worse than doing nothing. No fridge timeline is given here because refrigerating the whole tuber is the wrong thing to do, not because we could not find a number. Refrigerate only peeled or cut pieces, submerged in water, and use them within a day or two.
en.freezer: Peel, cube and boil the yam, then freeze it; or freeze the cooked, pounded purée. About 10–12 months at −18 °C (0 °F) is the working limit, borrowed from the timeline for cooked, mashed potato rather than published for ñame. Do not freeze it raw: raw frozen yam turns grey and watery, because the starch granules and the cell walls both come apart without the cooking that would have set them.
en.thawing: Reheat frozen cooked yam from frozen, in a pan, a steamer or a stew. Do not thaw it on the counter. Pounded yam purée is best reheated with a splash of water and worked smooth again.
spoilage: Soft, wet or sunken patches, especially at either end
Internal browning or dark rings when you cut across the tuber
Mould in the rough bark, usually starting at a cut or a bruise
A sour or fermented smell rather than a clean starchy one
tips: Spread the tubers out with plenty of air around them; a pile or a bag is how ñame rots.
Rub off sprouts as they appear rather than waiting.
Cut only what you need and seal the face of the remainder.
Do not confuse it with sweet potato — in American shops 'yam' usually means the sweet potato, which stores quite differently.

faq.a: About 2–4 months in a cool, dark, ventilated pantry, spread out and never bagged. That figure is borrowed from potatoes and stretched; no agency publishes one for ñame.
Not whole. It is chilling sensitive, and the fridge brings on internal browning and rot faster than a cool pantry. Refrigerate only cut pieces, submerged in water, for a day or two.
Yes, but cook it first — boiled cubes or pounded purée, about 10–12 months at −18 °C (0 °F), a figure borrowed from cooked mashed potato. Raw frozen yam turns grey and watery.

faq.q: Is ñame the same as a sweet potato?
faq.a: No. A true yam is a Dioscorea with rough bark and dry starchy flesh. American supermarkets often label orange sweet potatoes as 'yams', but they are a different plant with different storage rules.

zh.name: 熱帶山藥
zh.summary: ñame 是真正的熱帶山藥：外皮粗糙如樹皮、澱粉質高，通常以沉甸甸的長段販售——它不是美國超市貼著「yam」標籤的地瓜。它是耐貯作物，放在陰涼、避光、通風的儲藏處可放 2～4 個月，而且整根不該冷藏。
zh.pantry: 真正的山藥是耐貯作物，儲藏室才是它該待的地方：陰涼、避光、乾燥，最重要的是通風良好，攤開放而不是堆疊，也絕對不要裝在塑膠袋裡。約 2～4 個月是工作上的參考範圍——這個數字是比照馬鈴薯並往上調整，因為西非與加勒比海地區的 ñame 傳統上就是放在通風的倉房裡存放數月，遠比馬鈴薯久。沒有任何食品安全單位公布它的家庭保存期限。請定期檢查有沒有軟塌處，看到芽就搓掉。切開過的那一根請封住切面，並在幾天內用完。
zh.fridge: 整根 ñame 不要冷藏。和其他熱帶根莖一樣，它對低溫敏感，冰箱會讓內部褐變和腐敗來得比放在陰涼儲藏處更快——低溫在這裡不是保護，而是主動造成傷害。這裡不提供冷藏天數，理由是「整根冷藏本來就是錯的做法」，而不是我們找不到數字。只有削好或切開的部分才需要冷藏，泡在水裡，並在一兩天內用完。
zh.freezer: 請去皮、切塊、煮熟後再冷凍，或把搗好的山藥泥冷凍。−18°C 下約 10～12 個月是工作上限，這個數字是比照煮熟的馬鈴薯泥而來，並非針對 ñame 公布。不要生凍：生的山藥冷凍後會發灰出水，因為澱粉粒和細胞壁都在缺少加熱定型的情況下崩解了。
zh.thawing: 煮熟冷凍的山藥請不解凍，直接下鍋、蒸或加進燉菜裡加熱。不要放室溫解凍。搗好的山藥泥復熱時加一點水再重新攪打到滑順最好。
spoilage: 出現軟爛、滲水或凹陷的部位，尤其是兩端
橫切後內部出現褐變或深色環紋
粗糙的外皮上長黴，通常從切口或碰傷處開始
有酸味或發酵味，而不是乾淨的澱粉香
tips: 攤開放、四周留足夠空氣；堆疊或裝袋正是 ñame 腐爛的原因。
一看到發芽就搓掉，不要拖。
要用多少切多少，剩下的切面封好。
別和地瓜搞混——美國超市的「yam」通常指的是地瓜，保存方式完全不同。

faq.a: 陰涼、避光、通風的儲藏處，攤開不裝袋，約 2～4 個月。這個數字是比照馬鈴薯並往上調整；沒有單位為它公布過數字。
整根不要。它對低溫敏感，冰箱會讓內部褐變和腐敗比放陰涼處更快發生。只有切開的部分才泡水冷藏，並在一兩天內用完。
可以，但要先煮熟——水煮的塊或搗成泥，−18°C 下約 10～12 個月，這個數字是比照煮熟的馬鈴薯泥而來。生凍會發灰出水。

faq.q: ñame 和地瓜是同一種嗎？
faq.a: 不是。真正的山藥屬於薯蕷屬，外皮粗糙、肉質乾而富澱粉。美國超市常把橘色地瓜標成「yam」，但那是完全不同的植物，保存規則也不同。
